verdict.rationale: Asana documents a public RESTful JSON API with an in-context API explorer, quick-start token auth, and official JavaScript and Python libraries. It also publishes OpenAPI specs in an official GitHub repo, offers a developer sandbox, runs a formal deprecation process with Asana-Change/Enable headers, and serves markdown docs via llms.txt for AI consumption. The probe's 404s on well-known OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the spec is published on GitHub. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
